question: If x + (1)/(x) = 2sqrt 5 \: where x > 1, then the value of x³ - (1)/({{x³)}} is:
solution:
**Given :**

 x + (1)/(x) = 2√ 5 \: where x > 1,

**Formula used:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

(a - b)2 = a2 + b2 - 2ab

(a - b)³ = a³ - b³ - 3ab (a - b)

**Calculation:**

 (x + (1)/(x) )² = x² + ((1)/(x) )² + 2 

20 = x2 + ((1)/(x) )2 + 2 

x2 + ((1)/(x) )2 = 20 - 2 =18 .....(1)

(x - (1)/(x) )2 = x2 + ((1)/(x) )2 - 2 , Put the value of equation (1),

 (x - (1)/(x) )2 = 18 - 2 = 16

 (x - (1)/(x) ) = 4 ....(2)

apply cube power to equation 2 both side,

 => (x - (1)/(x) )³ = 4³

=> (x - (1)/(x) )3 = x3 - (1)/({{x³)}} - 3( x - (1)/(x) ) = 64, put the value of equation (2)

=> x3 - (1)/({{x³)}} - 3( 4 ) = 64

=> x3 - (1)/({{x³)}} = 64 + 12 

=> x3 - (1)/({{x³)}} = 76

Hence, **'76' **is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

If x + (1)/(x) = a then x - 1/x = √(a² - 4)

If x - 1/x = k then x³ - 1/x³ = k³ + 3k

Here, x + (1)/(x) = 2sqrt 5 \: then x - 1/x = √(20 - 4) = 4, then x3 - 1/x3 = (4³ + 12) = 76
